with the chance that the VAT (ICMS) CDA has some payment (GARE) in that year? **Dependent variable.** $y_{it}=1$ if CDA $i$ had collections $>0$ in year $t$; $0$ otherwise. **Logit model** (McFadden, 1974): $$\Pr(y_{it}=1)=\Lambda\big(\beta_0+\beta_1\,\text{rate}_{i,t-1}+\beta_2\ln(1+\text{stock}_{it})+\beta_3\,\text{age}_{it}+\gamma'\,\mathbf{m}_t\big),\qquad \Lambda(u)=\frac{1}{1+e^{-u}}$$ where With 9 years (2017–2025) at most 8 year-level regressors fit; the 11 series together are not identifiable. Conservative column: **two-step** regression of the 9 year effects of the reference model on the macro series (OLS; Donald & Lang, 2007). **Window.** 2026 excluded (incomplete year in collections and macro series). A `5a+` band that is large in value and small in GARE in the current year is an old portfolio, not proof that "it is not recovered early"; the GARE value window is in 7C2. ### First GARE (age at first payment) The chart of age at first GARE uses **only CDAs with at least one year of `arrecadado > 0`** and a non-negative delay. The percentage is within that group, not within all CDAs. CDAs with no observed GARE are left out of the curve: they do not count as "paid in year 0". The subtitle separates three populations: all CDAs in the panel, those with ≥1 GARE, and those with no observed GARE. This is not the subset still open in the cut-off year's stock. The grain is **annual** (year of the first `arrecadado > 0` minus the year of `data_inscricao`). It is not the date of the GARE document; that date enters in 7C2. Payment before the first year of the panel is not seen. ### Settlement (proxy — there is no registration status) The panel has no `situacao`, write-off date or settlement flag. These fields were not imputed. **Proxy used:** the first year in which the CDA's sum of `arrecadado`, accumulated from the first year it appears in the panel, reaches the `estoque_medio` of that opening year (`estoque_abertura > 0`). The age is the year of that crossing minus the enrolment year. The chart shows **only the CDAs for which the proxy fires**. CDAs with a valid opening stock that do not cross by the last observed year stay as **still open under the proxy**, outside the curve. A null or ≤ 0 opening stock leaves the proxy undefined (also outside). It is not an administrative write-off: the opening stock is not the value at the enrolment date when the CDA existed before the panel; later interest can raise the stock above what the proxy treats as covered; a stock reduction without corresponding collections does not fire the proxy. ### Enrolment cohort × years after enrolment The **lines by cohort** chart (enrolment year) replaces the heatmap. Each line is the cumulative percentage of the cohort with **some** GARE up to that number of years after enrolment. The denominator is **all CDAs of the cohort in the panel**, not only those that paid and not only those still open. Cohorts before the first year of the panel are left out, so as not to count as delay a GARE that the database does not see. Horizons not yet observable **do not enter the line** (they are not zero).
